location_exception_reason: PEB is a nationwide industrial commodity; location is not a buyer decision factor. Structural performance is governed by IS standards applied uniformly across India, not by regional origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, EPC) are redundant in PEB titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PEB Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged — it is still a PEB structure.
